title: Google, Meet OKRs
coreMove: Separate the ambition from the evidence by naming one objective and the key results that would prove it is moving.
sourcePressure: Google has ambition, capital, and technology, but Doerr introduces OKRs as the execution discipline that turns scale pressure into visible priorities and proof.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Do not reduce the opening to generic goal setting or startup inspiration.

sourceAnchors.name: Larry Page and Sergey Brin
sourceAnchors.detail: Doerr meets the Google founders after a major investment and sees strong technology, big ambition, and weak operating clarity.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Larry Page and Sergey Brin already had the room leaning toward the future; the missing piece was a way to keep that future from scattering into every attractive project.

sourceAnchors.name: Andy Grove
sourceAnchors.detail: Doerr learned OKRs at Intel under Andy Grove before bringing the discipline to Google.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The method arrived at Google with Intel fingerprints on it: Grove had taught Doerr to make ambition answer to proof.

hook: A team discovers OKRs in a conference room and suddenly gets aligned
A dashboard glows on a Monday morning and reveals the truth
A leader writes a goal on a whiteboard and everyone understands
opening with Google, Meet OKRs as a definition rather than a pressure
counterintuition: Measurement is not bureaucracy, it is clarity
Goals are not dreams, they are systems
Accountability is not punishment, it is ownership
OKRs is not a mindset, it is a system
tryThisNow: Set a timer and write three goals
Ask yourself what matters most right now
write one OKR without checking whether it changes behavior
examples: generic startup roadmap meeting with sticky notes
home chore chart with vague family goals
student group in a classroom choosing priorities
team lead reviewing a color-coded dashboard

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person direct address, retrospective, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

skillTargets: distinguish objectives from key results in scale-pressure scenarios
choose proof lines that expose movement rather than activity
identify when transparency turns private hope into coordination

tryThisNowSpec: Take one active goal and split it into one objective plus two proof lines you would be willing to show another person this week.
